integrity: Analytic Cauchy-ratio proof, exact rational witness and a reproducible standard-library verifier. No independent audit or computational certificate for universal quantifiers is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One specified 2-by-2 SPD double-saddle-point family, exact first Schur term, standard real Gaussian rank-one sketch and exact arithmetic only; fixed positive signed-core ridges but no generic rank or sparse-sketch guarantee. The abstract of one relevant newer full text was available, not its full paper.
title: Exact failure probability and infinite-mean tails for Gaussian indefinite Nyström Schur corrections
